lesson.title: A figure wider than the column
lesson.skill: Read a wide drawing without losing the column of prose beside it.
lesson.missionLink: The practice set has a table of common mistakes, and it is wider than the page. This is that table, drawn.

primarySource.why: It prints the comparison wide, on purpose.

content.text: This drawing is much wider than the text column. It has to scroll inside itself.

blocks.source: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 200" width="1600" height="200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="1600" height="200" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="40" y="110" font-size="16">a wide table drawn as a diagram</text></svg>
blocks.alt: A wide table drawn as a diagram
blocks.caption: Scroll sideways to read the last column.
